title: Keep delegated decisions visible before execution
text: The companion material describes an operating manual and a visible review surface for proposed email or customer actions. A person owns exceptional cases and approvals; the agent’s intermediate work remains inspectable. This offers a concrete alternative to an opaque personal automation.
qualification: An attributed workflow pattern, not a tested guarantee. Visibility must be paired with reviewer capacity and enforceable permissions.
